desc: 玄镜控光显通透油润，素圈镯型与腕间佩戴一套讲清
name: 温润通透素圈玉镯款

shots.intent: 用镜漆底与顶部轮廓光把镯身的通透感和抛光光泽一眼立住，抢搜索点击。
以三枚并置与编号主张，一秒讲清「一生值得拥有的三只镯」的情感购买理由。
shots.textZone: upper center headline band, one short label under each of the three pieces

shots.intent: 放大线上买镯最大的顾虑：圈口量不准、怕戴不上也退不回。
手腕特写做代入感，让买家看见自己戴上后的比例与光泽。
微距证明料质：表面抛光细腻、内部通透有油性光泽。
正侧机位交代镯型与条宽壁厚，用占位标注解答版型疑问。
shots.textZone: right third kept clean for hairline callouts

shots.intent: 用器物与缎面把颜色与温润度放进一个可代入的中式静物语境。
shots.textZone: top left quiet corner reserved for a short subtitle

shots.intent: 把规格讲成一张干净信息卡，数值全用占位符，避免虚标。
shots.textZone: structured two-column table filling the lower two thirds

shots.intent: 多镯型多圈口同框，让买家自己挑到合适的版型。
shots.textZone: one short label under each cell

shots.intent: 手把手戴镯六步图，把「怕戴不上」的最后一道心理门槛拆掉。
shots.textZone: one short step label beneath each of the six frames

shots.intent: 以真实的养护动作与无标收纳建立可靠感，不用证书堆信任。
shots.textZone: four small labels in a quiet column at the right

shots.intent: 收口把情感主张落到一个动作上，完成详情页的最后一推。
shots.textZone: headline band above the product, one action button below it

style.backgroundSystem: recurring lacquer field #14120F alternating with linen field #F2EDE4; stone linen #6E6A64, satin accent field #8E1B22 and one single satin panel #C9A227 used as rhythm breaks; a visible supporting surface in every frame, depth from real fall-off only, never a gradient
style.direction: premium oriental-restraint jewelry ecommerce, gallery-still-life staging
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and small solid numbered circles in #C9A227, one icon per label, no 3D badges, no seal or certificate artwork
style.lightingSystem: neutral 5500K studio light, large soft key from the upper left, right-side fill bounce, narrow top-rear rim that reads the product's translucency, inner glow and polished surface luster; single-direction soft shadows, one grounded contact shadow per frame, one clean mirror reflection allowed only on #14120F
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent premium oriental-restraint jewelry ecommerce visual system across the whole set; fixed palette of lacquer field #14120F, linen field #F2EDE4, stone linen #6E6A64, one satin accent field #8E1B22, and hairline accent #C9A227 reserved for rules, numbered markers, icons and one single satin panel; neutral 5500K studio light, large soft key from the upper left, right-side fill bounce, narrow top-rear rim that reads the product's translucency and polished surface luster, single-direction soft shadows with one grounded contact shadow per frame; one modern geometric sans-serif family only, short Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」; the product presented on a visible surface at a stable scale, never floating; thin single-weight line icon system; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no added sparkle, glow or lens flares.
noDrift: no added sparkle, glow or lens flares
no invented certificates, grades, origins or prices
style.presentationRules: the product keeps one stable scale and the same slight 3/4 turn wherever it is presented in full; it always rests on a surface, never floats; all numeric specification values appear only as {callout_*} placeholders; no material, origin, grade or health assertion is drawn in-frame
style.surfaceSystem: matte linen #F2EDE4, stone linen #6E6A64, satin #8E1B22, satin panel #C9A227, polished lacquer disc #14120F; low matte risers and plain carved blocks so a circular band form can stand on its edge
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for all rendered copy; short Chinese in-image text always wrapped in 「」, headline 28-40pt, subtitle 16-18pt, labels 10-14pt; source calligraphy and decorative lettering deliberately excluded
